plain.li: The fight again, and I was down again, and {OTHER_nameDef} came for me again. In the dream it took no time at all.
Dreamt I was lying in the open and couldn't call out, and then {OTHER_nameDef}'s hands were there, the same as on the day.
In the dream I was the one who went out for {OTHER_nameDef}. I woke up and remembered it the right way round.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} came for me in my sleep again. I'm starting to count on it.
[hurt] Every time I turned over in the night the hurt woke me, and every time I slept again {OTHER_nameDef} was there.

warm.li: Dreamt of the moment {OTHER_nameDef} reached me. I've thanked {OTHER_objective}, but I don't think I've said it properly yet.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came for me. Dreamt it twice in one night. I owe {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} carried me off the field like a sack of grain and complained the whole way. Sounds right.

gloomy.li: In the dream nobody came. I lay there until I woke. Then I remembered {OTHER_nameDef} did.

cold.li: I went over the fight in my sleep. Without {OTHER_nameDef}, it ends differently. I'm aware of that.

plain.li: Dreamt I was still on the road, and woke up surprised to find a roof over me.
In the dream the caravan kept going past the colony and nobody would stop, and I could see my own bed through the window.
Dreamt of the last camp before home, the fire, the packs, the cold ground. Here, I woke up warm.
Every night out there I dreamt of home. Now I'm home I dream of the road. There's no pleasing me.
[lowtech] Dreamt I was leading the pack animals in a circle round the colony, and none of us could find the gate.
[child] I dreamt we were still going, and going, and I asked if we were there yet a hundred times.

warm.li: Dreamt the whole colony was waiting at the edge of the fields when we came in, with supper on.

blunt.li: Road dream. My feet still think they're walking.

cheerful.li: Dreamt we went out again the very next day, and I didn't mind a bit. Don't tell anyone.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I came home and nobody knew who I was. They did, this morning. I checked.

cold.li: My sleep is still keeping the caravan's hours. It will settle in a few days.

plain.li: The wedding again, all of it, and this time I remembered every word I meant to say to {OTHER_nameDef}.
Dreamt the wedding went on for a week and nobody had to go back to work.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I were married all over again, in a different place every time, and it was always right.
[again] Married {OTHER_nameDef} in my sleep again. That's three times now.

warm.li: Dreamt I turned round at the wedding and everyone I've ever loved was there, the living and the gone, and {OTHER_nameDef} was holding my hand.

blunt.li: Dreamt of the wedding. Good day. Twice now.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} stepped on my feet all through the dancing and I laughed the whole night.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I forgot the words at the wedding, and {OTHER_nameDef} didn't mind at all. I woke up glad of that.

cold.li: I dreamt of the ceremony. Pleasant. I find I'm still pleased about it.

plain.li: Dreamt of the baby. {OTHER_nameDef} was laughing at the way I held it.
In the dream the baby was already walking, and {OTHER_nameDef} and I ran after it through the fields.
Dreamt I was making a cradle, and every time I finished it I started a better one.
Dreamt we gave the baby a name, and woke up and couldn't remember it. {OTHER_nameDef} says that's a sign.

warm.li: Dreamt I sat up all night with the baby so {OTHER_nameDef} could sleep. I think I'd like to.

blunt.li: Baby dream. Not here yet. Soon.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the baby had {OTHER_nameDef}'s laugh and my appetite. Good luck to all of us.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the baby, and it was well, and so was {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm holding on to that one.

cold.li: A dream about the child. I've started listing what we'll need.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long night

plain.li: Dreamt the baby came and I didn't know what to do with my hands. Nobody did.
In the dream I was looking for {OTHER_nameDef} through every room, and every room had a cradle in it.
Dreamt the stores ran out the day the baby came, and I counted them over and over.

blunt.li: Bad dream about the baby. Not ready. Will have to be.

gloomy.li: Dreamt we weren't enough for a child. I lay awake after, listing all the ways.

cold.li: An anxious dream about the child. I know where it comes from.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of saying it all

plain.li: Dreamt I said everything I'd kept in, out loud at the table, and nobody even looked up from their bowls.
In the dream I threw every plate in the kitchen, and they bounced, and I laughed until I cried.
Dreamt I walked out past the last field and kept going, and then came back, because I wanted to.
I slept like a stone after it all. The only dream was of rain on a roof.

warm.li: Dreamt the others were kind about it. They have been, mostly, awake.

blunt.li: Dreamt I did it again. Felt good. Won't.

gloomy.li: Dreamt they all remembered it, word for word, and wrote it down. I hope they don't.

cold.li: A quiet dream, for once. Whatever was building up has gone.

plain.li: Dreamt we were all standing round the grave again, and nobody had brought a spade, and nobody minded.
In the dream the funeral went on into the night, and the words got better the longer we stood there.
Dreamt I was the one saying the words, and I knew them all, and I'd never learned them.
[lowtech] Dreamt the smoke from the burial rose straight up and didn't come down anywhere.

warm.li: Dreamt the one we buried came and stood at the back, and nodded, and went.

blunt.li: Funeral dream. Done once. Didn't need it twice.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the grave and woke up counting how much ground we've set aside for them. Too much.

cold.li: I dreamt of the funeral. The mind goes back over what matters.

plain.li: The music from last night kept playing in my sleep, and I knew every note of it.
Dreamt I could play, too, and everyone stopped to listen, and I didn't drop a single note.
In the dream the music went on after the players had gone to bed, coming out of the walls.
[child] I danced in my dream and the music didn't stop when it was bedtime.

warm.li: Dreamt we were all singing, even the ones who never sing. Especially them.

blunt.li: Still hearing the music. Fine by me.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I danced till the floor gave way and we all kept dancing on the ground under it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the music stopped and I couldn't remember how it went. Then I hummed it at breakfast.

cold.li: The tune from last night, all night. It's still going.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the pens in spring

plain.li: Dreamt the pens were full of young, more than we had names for, and I tried to name them all.
In the dream the newborn followed me round all day, and the whole herd followed it.
Dreamt I woke at the pens with the young one asleep against me, and it was warm, and the frost was gone.
[child] I dreamt the baby animal let me carry it everywhere.

warm.li: Dreamt of the first young of the year, and its mother looking at me as if I'd done well.

blunt.li: Dreamt of the pens. The young one's doing fine, last I saw.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the new one grew up in a night and led the whole herd out to graze.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the young one was well and the winter was over. I'm writing it down so I believe it.

cold.li: A dream of the herd growing. I'll look at the feed tomorrow.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the place before

plain.li: Dreamt of where I came from, and when I turned round this place was there instead.
In the dream I was still looking for somewhere to sleep, and every place was taken. Then I woke up here.
Dreamt the colony was already built, every wall and field, and I walked round it without knowing who'd done it.
[tribal] Dreamt of the old camp's fire, and the smoke drifting all the way here.
[child] I dreamt about our old home. I think I miss it a little.

warm.li: Dreamt we'd been here for years, all of us, and knew each other's ways. We will.

blunt.li: New place, new dreams. Couldn't tell you what they were.

cheerful.li: Dreamt this place was ours already and the roof didn't leak. Half true.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the old life, the whole of it. Then this one. I don't know which was the dream.

cold.li: I dream of the place before. The mind takes time to learn new ground.

plain.li: Dreamt of last night's supper, and it was better the second time.
In the dream the pot never got any emptier however many bowls we filled from it.
Dreamt I asked the cook how it was done, and they told me, and I forgot it all on waking.
[child] I dreamt there was pudding at every meal.

warm.li: Dreamt we all ate together and nobody was in a hurry. We were, last night, a little.

blunt.li: Dreamt about supper. Good supper.

cheerful.li: Ate the whole meal again in my sleep. Woke up hungry anyway.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of a good meal and woke up afraid we'd not have another. We will. I'll count the stores again.

cold.li: A dream about food, after good food. Predictable.

plain.li: Dreamt of a table, a plain long one with a bench each side. That was the whole dream.
In the dream I kept looking for somewhere to set my bowl down, and the floor kept moving away.
Dreamt we all sat down to eat at a table so big it took a day to walk round.

blunt.li: Dreamt of a table. Someone build one.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of chairs. Lovely chairs. With backs.

gloomy.li: Ate off my knees again, and dreamt of it. Even my dreams eat standing up.

cold.li: A dream about furniture. The colony needs a table.

plain.li: Dreamt the hive was still humming under the ground, and I put my ear to the floor to listen. Nothing. Good.
In the dream the tunnels went on under the whole colony, and I walked them with a light, and they were empty.
Dreamt of the jelly, glowing in the dark where the hive was, and woke with the smell of it in my nose.

blunt.li: Hive dream. They're dead. I was there.

cheerful.li: Dreamt we turned the whole cave into a cellar. Not the worst idea.

gloomy.li: Dreamt there was another hive, deeper. There might be.

cold.li: I dreamt of the hive's layout. I could draw it now.

plain.li: Dreamt the machines we brought down got up one by one and walked off over the hill without looking at us.
In the dream I was taking the cluster apart with my hands, and inside every piece was another smaller one.
Dreamt the ground where the cluster stood grew grass overnight.

blunt.li: Machines in my sleep. All dead. Fine.

cheerful.li: Dreamt we used the scrap to build a mill. Somebody should.

gloomy.li: Dreamt another one fell from the sky the morning after. I keep looking up.

cold.li: I went over the assault on the cluster in my sleep. We could do it faster.

plain.li: Dreamt the room kept tipping, and I kept setting my cup down on a table that wasn't there.
In the dream I was still at the table, and everyone had gone to bed, and I was telling the chairs a story.
Dreamt I sang the whole of a song I don't know. Woke with a dry mouth and the tune.
[again] The spinning dream again. I know what brings it on.

warm.li: Dreamt I told everyone at the table how much I liked them. I may have done that awake, too.

blunt.li: Drank. Dreamt. Head hurts.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the party never ended. My head says it did.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I said something at the table I shouldn't have. I can't remember if I did.

cold.li: Unsettled sleep after drinking. As expected.

plain.li: A slow, warm dream. I was lying in long grass watching one cloud for the whole night.
Dreamt I understood why the birds sing in the morning. It was very simple. I've lost it now.
In the dream everything was funny, even the stores, especially the stores.

blunt.li: Slow dream. Slept late.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I was a cloud. Good work if you can get it.

gloomy.li: A soft dream, for once. Woke up and the day was hard again straight away.

cold.li: A blurred, pleasant sleep. Not useful, but pleasant.

plain.li: Dreamt of bread, a whole warm loaf, and every time I reached for it someone else's hand got there first.
In the dream the stores were full to the roof, and when I opened the door it was only the wind.
Dreamt I was eating and eating and my stomach stayed empty, a hole the size of a fist.
[lowtech] Dreamt the hunters came back with a whole herd on their shoulders, and woke to the same thin broth.
[child] I dreamt about food all night. Is there any more?

warm.li: Dreamt I gave my bowl to someone hungrier. Woke up hungry, but I'd do it.

blunt.li: Dreamt of food. Woke up starving. Same as yesterday.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of a whole roast with all the trimmings. Woke up chewing on the blanket.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of every meal I ever left unfinished. I'd eat them all now.

cold.li: I dream of food because there isn't enough. The fix is food.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the little one

plain.li: Dreamt of the little one, the weight of it in my arms, and woke with my hands still curved round nothing.
In the dream the baby was already here and looked at me as if it had known me all along.
Dreamt I was swimming, and the water held all of me up at once. Woke heavy again.
Dreamt the baby kicked so hard it woke me. Then it did.

warm.li: Dreamt the whole colony came to see the baby, one at a time, and each of them brought something small.

blunt.li: Baby dream. Back hurts. Worth it.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the baby came out talking and asked what was for supper. That's mine all right.

gloomy.li: Dreamt it all went well. I'm holding on to that one for the next few weeks.

cold.li: A dream of the child. The body has one subject at the moment.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a feast out of reach

plain.li: Dreamt of a feast laid out on the long table, and I couldn't eat a bite of it.
In the dream I was a stewpot, bubbling, with someone stirring me with a big spoon.
Dreamt I swallowed a stone and spent the night carrying it about inside me.
[child] I dreamt my tummy was a drum and someone kept playing it.

blunt.li: Stomach dream. Stomach's no better.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I could eat again and ate a whole cake. Soon, maybe.

gloomy.li: Dreamt my insides were full of something with teeth. I'd rather not know if it's true.

cold.li: The dream was about my stomach. Everything is, at the moment.

plain.li: Dreamt I could see every leaf on the far trees, every one, and none of it stung.
In the dream the whole world was behind frosted glass, and I kept wiping it, and it kept fogging.
Dreamt I was looking at the colony from the top of a hill, sharp as a drawing. Woke up and rubbed my eyes.
[child] I dreamt my eyes were better and I could see in the dark like a cat.

blunt.li: Dreamt I could see. Can't, much. Few more days.

cheerful.li: Dreamt my eyes were fine and I spent all night reading the clouds.

gloomy.li: Dreamt it was always going to be like this, the blur. It won't. They tell me it won't.

cold.li: A dream of clear sight. A wish, plainly.

plain.li: Dreamt I lay down in a cold stream and let it run over me all night.
In the dream it snowed, just on me, and I stood in it with my arms out.
Dreamt of a cellar so cool the walls sweated, and I pressed my back to them.
[child] I dreamt I swam in a lake full of ice and it was lovely.

blunt.li: Cold water dream. Skin still burns.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of a bath full of snow. Best dream all week.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of cold water and woke up hot and itching. A cruel sort of dream.

cold.li: I dreamt of cold. The skin knows what it wants.

plain.li: Dreamt I walked the whole round of the fields without once thinking about my feet.
In the dream I had new feet, and I kept looking down at them, and they kept walking.
Dreamt the ground was soft as a bed all the way to the far trees.

blunt.li: Walking dream. Real walking's still sore.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I danced all night and my feet didn't say a word about it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I was walking, and every step was a little further than I could manage.

cold.li: A dream of walking without pain. It will come back to me in a few days.

plain.li: In the dream I was in the fight again, and I knew what was coming, and I still couldn't move fast enough.
Dreamt I was keeping watch long after the fight was done, and nobody came to tell me it was over.
[tribal] Dreamt my spear was the length of a grass stalk, and they kept coming over the rise.
[tribal] In the dream I loosed arrow after arrow, and every one fell short and stuck in the ground like a fence.
[medieval] Dreamt the gate wouldn't bar, and I stood holding it shut with my back while they pushed.
[medieval] In the dream my shield was made of bread, and I held it up anyway.
[industrial] Dreamt my rifle jammed, and I worked the bolt over and over, and it never cleared.
[industrial] In the dream I was behind the sandbags, and every bag I filled the rain washed out.
[spacer] Dreamt the turrets turned and looked at me, all of them, and waited.
[spacer] In the dream my rifle's charge was running down, and the little light went from green to nothing.
[hurt] Every time I turned in the bed the wound woke me, and every time I slept I was back in the fight.

warm.li: Dreamt I lost sight of the others in the fight and ran from one to the next, counting. All there.

blunt.li: The fight, all night. Up anyway.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the raiders gave up halfway and asked for supper. Would've saved us a lot of trouble.

gloomy.li: Dreamt we didn't hold. I'll walk the walls before I eat.

cold.li: I went over the fight in my sleep. Two of my moves were wrong. I know which.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an ordinary morning

plain.li: Dreamt of an ordinary morning: the fire lit, someone grumbling about the cold, nothing coming over the hill.
In the dream we were mending the walls, all of us, and talking about something else entirely.
Dreamt the scorch marks and the holes were gone and the grass had grown back over everything.
[child] I dreamt the bad people went home and we had a picnic.

warm.li: Dreamt we all sat down together after it, every one of us, and I counted, and nobody was missing.

blunt.li: Dreamt it was over. It is. Good.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the raiders sent a letter saying sorry. A nice touch, I thought.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of a quiet morning. Woke up and it was one. I don't trust it yet.

cold.li: A dream of the day after. Repairs, mostly. I'll start on them.

plain.li: Dreamt the rows came up overnight, green to the edge of the fields, and I walked them barefoot.
In the dream I could hear the plants growing, a sound like slow breathing.
Dreamt I found the perfect soil, dark and crumbling, and I knew exactly what to put in it.
[again] The field dream again. The rows were straighter this time.

warm.li: Dreamt I planted something for each of them, one row each, and they all came up.

blunt.li: Field dream. Need to weed the east rows.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the vegetables were so big we had to roll them home. Fine by me.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of blight, then dreamt it away. Going out to check the leaves.

cold.li: A dream about yields. I'll try closer planting on the south side.

plain.li: Dreamt of a dish I've never made, and I could taste every part of it. Now I have to work out how.
In the dream the whole colony came in for supper at once, and I fed them all from one pot.
Dreamt I'd forgotten the salt, and every bowl came back to me, one after another.
[lowtech] Dreamt the fire under the pot burned blue and never needed feeding.

warm.li: Dreamt I cooked each of them their favourite, and I knew them all without asking.

blunt.li: Cooking dream. Trying something tonight.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the stew talked back. It wanted more pepper. It was right.

gloomy.li: Dreamt everyone left their bowls full. I'll make the usual tonight, I think.

cold.li: I dreamt a recipe. Half of it is probably useful.

plain.li: Dreamt the rock opened like a door when I knocked on it, and inside was a room lined with silver.
In the dream I followed a seam all night, deeper and deeper, and it was warm down there.
Dreamt I could hear the hollow places in the hill, and I marked every one.
[again] The seam dream again. I'm going to try further along it.

blunt.li: Dreamt of digging. Going digging.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I struck gold with my first swing. One day.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the roof came down slowly, very slowly, and I watched it. I'll check the supports.

cold.li: A dream about the rock's grain. Possibly accurate.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a raised roof

plain.li: Dreamt I built a hall with a roof so high the birds lived in it, and not one beam was crooked.
In the dream every wall I set went up true the first time, and I didn't need the level once.
Dreamt I walked round the colony and knew exactly where every stone should go.
[tribal] Dreamt of a lodge so big the whole tribe could sleep in it round one fire.
[spacer] Dreamt of a dome with the stars on the other side of the glass, and I'd fitted every pane.

warm.li: Dreamt I built a room for each of them, just how they'd want it.

blunt.li: Building dream. Got ideas.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I put up a tower just to see if I could. I could.

gloomy.li: Dreamt everything I'd built fell down at once, very quietly. I'll go round and look.

cold.li: I dreamt a better way to lay out the rooms. I'll draw it before it goes.

plain.li: Dreamt I had the answer, the whole of it, written on the wall in my own hand. Gone on waking.
In the dream every book I opened was about the thing I've been puzzling over, and each said something different.
Dreamt I was explaining it to someone, and halfway through I understood it myself.
[lowtech] Dreamt the stars were a sum, and I could nearly add it up.

blunt.li: Had an idea in my sleep. Writing it down.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I solved everything. Breakfast was harder.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I'd been wrong about all of it from the start. Going back over my notes.

cold.li: A dream that rearranged a problem. One part of it holds up in daylight.

plain.li: Dreamt of a shape I've never seen, and my hands knew how to make it before I did.
In the dream the block of stone told me what was inside it, and I only had to take the rest away.
Dreamt I made something so good nobody spoke for a while. I want to make it.
[again] The shape again. Closer.

warm.li: Dreamt I made something for the whole colony, and everyone found themselves in it.

blunt.li: Dreamt a piece. Starting it today.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I carved a bird and it flew off. Rude, but flattering.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I'd made the best thing I'll ever make, and it was already finished. Nothing after it.

cold.li: I dreamt a composition. I'll sketch it before it goes.

plain.li: Dreamt I was young again, and ran up the hill without stopping, and the old people waved at me from the bottom.
In the dream my hands were smooth and quick and I kept looking at them.
Dreamt of the people I knew when I was twenty. Most of them are gone now, but not in the dream.
Dreamt I was a child and somebody called me in for supper. I haven't heard that voice in fifty years.

warm.li: Dreamt I told my young self how it all turns out. I told the good parts first.

blunt.li: Young in my sleep. Old again by breakfast. Knees told me.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I was young and danced all night. The young ones here should try it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I was young, and woke up to all these years. They came quickly.

cold.li: A dream of my youth. Age does this, I'm told.
